cardOverview.overviewText: A Duo Plus variant enhancing the Duo with higher cashback, lifestyle perks, and milestone benefits, designed for frequent spenders.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: When purchasing a movie ticket on BookMyShow, receive an additional free ticket once per month, with a maximum benefit capped at ₹250 monthly.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
